builds.name: Blooming Blows: outer-edge magic and true
builds.summary: Explore a high outer Blooming Blows impact result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high outer Blooming Blows impact result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 Q deals 75 + 0.35 AP magic, with an additional 75 + 0.35 AP true at the outer edge. AP improves both components; Void only helps the magic part. Shadowflame can be tested on eligible low-health magic/true packets; passive burn remains separate. This makes a pure-AP swap against Void worth checking.
